result:
Every query below was written from the documentation page alone and has not been run.

- **Keys and keywords:** map keys must be keywords, so grouping steps turn strings into keywords with `keyword`.
- **Number parsing:** `parseJson` reads numbers out of strings in K6 and K12.
- **Trimming:** the page lists no trim verb, so K11 removes spaces by splitting on `" "` and re-joining.
- **Name-keyed sorts:** K7 and K11 sort by key name, and `sort` on a map would drop the keys. They take `keys` first and look values up through a named copy of the map.

K1: ["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | count
K2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer | keyword) | * (* (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum)
K3: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " " | /1) | groupBy ~keyword | * count
K4: :d /devDependencies | /dependencies | union d | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys | * keyword | sort
K5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~[(at :comments | coalesce 0 | mul -1) /id] | take 3 | * /id
K6: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(/1 | count | gt 0) | * (/1 | parseJson) | :a / | a | sum | div (a | count) | mul 10 | round | div 10
K7: :m /services | m | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | filter ~(at :port | type | eq ::number) | keys | sort ~(:k / | m | at k | /port) | * (:k / | [(k | keyword) (m | at k | /port | print)] | join ":")
K8: /results | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | split "@" | last | lower | eq "example.com") | filter ~(/user/name/last | ne null) | * ([/user/name/last /user/name/first] | join ", ")
K9: filter ~(/user | ne null) | filter ~(/action | lower | eq "login") | * (/user | lower) | distinct | sort
K10: filter ~(at :salary | ne null) | groupBy ~(/dept | keyword) | * (:g / | g | * /salary | sum | div (g | count) | mul 100 | round | div 100)
K11: * (at :tags | coalesce "" | split "," | * (split " " | join "" | lower) | filter ~(count | gt 0)) | flat | groupBy ~keyword | * count | :c / | keys | sort ~[(:k / | c | at k | mul -1) /] | take 3 | * keyword
K12: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | * split "|" | * (mul (/1 | parseJson) (/2 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
K13: /services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(at :replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)
K14: * {:id /id :itemCount (at :items | coalesce [] | * /qty | sum)} | filter ~(/itemCount | gt 0) | sort ~[(/itemCount | mul -1) /id] | take 3
